name: std-learn-speed-drill
description: Generic speeded-response drill — a config-declared item roster of prompt + options runs against a live countdown: answering while the clock runs scores the base points plus a speed bonus proportional to the time left, letting the clock hit zero counts as a miss and reveals the answer, and a streak counter rewards consecutive hits with an end-of-round summary of score and best streak. All vocabulary and timing is config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any fluency drill: times tables, sight vocabulary, chemical symbols, flag recognition, interval identification — anywhere fast retrieval is the skill. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

emits.synonyms: speed drill, reaction time, fluency, timed quiz, countdown, rapid recall

events.name: Mode Selected
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: Answer
events.description: Learner picked an option while the clock was running — index is the chosen option; it is judged immediately and scored with a speed bonus.

events.name: Next
events.description: Learner advanced to the next item after a verdict (answered or timed out); past the last item this completes the round.

events.name: Retry
events.description: Learner restarted the round from the first item with a cleared score and streak.

events.name: Answer Judged
events.description: The verdict of a speeded answer: correctness, tenths of a second left on the clock, and the running score and streak — a composed listener (coach, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: speed drill, reaction time, fluency, timed quiz, countdown, rapid recall

events.name: Prompt Advanced
events.description: The learner moved to the next item (or completed the round) with the running score.

events.name: Round Restarted
events.description: The learner restarted the round from scratch.

events.name: Learn Round Complete
events.description: Fired once when the round finishes (advancing past the final prompt) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.

timeLimit.label: Time Limit
timeLimit.description: Seconds the learner has to answer each item before it counts as a miss.

speedBonus.label: Speed Bonus
speedBonus.description: Maximum extra points awarded in proportion to the time left on the clock.

items.label: Items
items.description: The drill roster; each item carries a prompt, its options, and the index of the correct option. Realizations declare their own subject's items here.

matchMode.label: Match Mode
matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

basePoints.label: Base Points
basePoints.description: Points for a correct answer regardless of speed.
